strategy: HTF wick sweep -> independent HTF POI -> M15 IFVG -> M15 sweep-origin CISD -> structural stop and opposing-liquidity target

assumptions.sweep: H1/H4 confirmed swing wick-only sweep; same as V1
assumptions.poi: Pre-existing independent H1/H4 OB, FVG or SR; same as V1
assumptions.run_origin: First of >=2 contiguous same-direction M15 candles nearest extreme of closed HTF sweep bar, <=2 candles before extreme
assumptions.ifvg: M15 opposite-color close inside FVG from original side, optional one CLOSED M15 hold below upper bound (sell)/above lower (buy)
assumptions.cisd: M15 displacement body >=1.2x median last20 and >=60% range; fresh CLOSE beyond first sweep-run candle low/high; IFVG overlap in last 3 M15 candles
assumptions.entry: Next M1 BID open after M15 CISD close; BUY pays 0.30 USD assumed ASK spread
assumptions.stop: Highest/lowest M15 wick since IFVG inversion until CISD plus 0.20 USD buffer
assumptions.target: Nearest prior confirmed and unconsumed M15/H1/H4 swing on opposing side, >=1 USD away
assumptions.exit: Target or stop first within 12 hours, otherwise close at 12h; within-M1 ambiguity treated as stop; 0.10 USD slippage each side
assumptions.cooldown: Four hours same direction; excludes signals lacking full 12h observation

warnings: The supplied explanation is from a second model, not independently verified from video.
The definition of the first sweep-run candle, POI and what constitutes a major liquidity pool remain discretionary; these are documented proxies.
One-bar IFVG hold is an assumption; cannot demand that price NEVER returns above IFVG without future leakage.
Targets are only chart-confirmed prior swing highs/lows, not actual resting orders or order book.
Sample sizes may be very small; do not infer strategy quality from isolated winners.
No real broker spread/ASK or slippage; assumed execution only.
Both variants are exploratory, not out-of-sample validated; do not select the winner on this same test period.
